description: 13.06 TERRAIN AND MOVEMENT (Dense): 'INFANTRY/BEASTS/SWARM/MOBILE models can move horizontally through dense terrain features' and 'INFANTRY/BEASTS/SWARM models can move vertically through dense terrain features'. Regression (bd9392c): get_terrain_at_position returns the terrain FEATURE at a point, and MovementPhase._get_vertical_climb_cost exempted INFANTRY only, so a BEASTS model stepping from its terrain area's open ground onto a dense wall in the same area climbed the wall's 6" (plus the area's 2" difficult ground): a Fenrisian Wolf (M10") 2.9" onto the wall cost 10.9" and the drop was refused, while a charge along the same line cost 0". Official layout take_and_hold_vs_reconnaissance_1 over the sw11e_s4_command fixture: the player selects the Fenrisian Wolves in the unit list, picks Normal Move and drags the wolf 2.9" west from area-large-7's open ground onto the dense L-wall corner-ruin-balanced-right-13; the live drag ruler reads 2.9" (green, within M), the drop is staged at the raw distance, and End This Unit's Move leaves the wolf on the wall.

steps.comment: a movement_phase_start window (not under test), if any

Setup: the official layout take_and_hold_vs_reconnaissance_1 (the fixture's own layout is restored in cleanup); one Fenrisian Wolf (BEASTS, M10", 40mm base) in the open ground of home objective area area-large-7 (x 25.5-37", y 48-55", dense, difficult ground) at (29", 51"), 2.9" east of the dense L-wall corner-ruin-balanced-right-13 (vertical arm x 25.84-26.34"); the pack's other wolves and every other unit but one far-away Boyz mob removed from play.

the wolves are the only row of the movement unit list
Real player input: select the Fenrisian Wolves in the unit list.
real drag, LMB still held: the wolf 2.9" west onto the dense wall

the live drag ruler (what the player reads while holding the model): the raw 2.9", green (within M). Before the fix it read the 10.9" move cost (red, out of reach) and the ghost was clamped short of the wall.
steps.script:
var mc = tree.root.get_node("Main").movement_controller
var r = mc.drag_ruler_visual
if r == null or not is_instance_valid(r):
	return "no ruler"
print("[%s] drag ruler: '%s' slot=%s inches=%.2f" % ["beasts_onto_dense_wall_no_climb_11e", r.label_text, r.label_slot, mc.drag_ruler_inches])
return "%s|%s" % [r.label_text, r.label_slot]

steps.comment: the drop is staged on the wall and booked at its raw distance (no climb, no difficult ground)
the move was accepted: the wolf ends on the dense wall, within area-large-7 (before the fix the drop was refused as 10.9" > 10" and the wolf snapped back)
steps.script:
var m = GameState.get_unit("U_FENRISIAN_WOLVES_A")["models"][0]
var p = m["position"]
var here = TerrainManager.get_terrain_at_position(Vector2(float(p.x), float(p.y)))
var ids = []
for pc in TerrainManager.pieces_model_within(m):
	ids.append(str(pc.get("id", "")))
print("[%s] after the move: (%.2f, %.2f)in on %s, within %s" % ["beasts_onto_dense_wall_no_climb_11e", float(p.x) / 40.0, float(p.y) / 40.0, str(here.get("id", "")), str(ids)])
return "%s|%s|%s" % [str(absf(float(p.x) / 40.0 - 26.1) < 0.3), str(here.get("id", "")), str("area-large-7" in ids)]
